notes: Open subset of the realistic O/D pairs (74 of 92). Realistic O/D pairs from public data (LODES 2023, OSM, GTFS, TRPA). Same schema as the curated draft (id, name, from, to, tags, why) plus source, purpose, straight_km and weight (sums to 1; purpose share x sqrt-demand within purpose). No usage or private data. Regenerate with build_trips.py. 6 pairs dropped by check-pairs (an endpoint had no bicycle edge within 150 m); remaining endpoints are stored snapped.
weight_note: weight is relative: weights sum to 1 over the full pair set, so this subset sums to 0.7373.
